name: Hypr Screen
author: kpanuragh
description: Sidecar-style second screen for Omarchy: extend your desktop onto your Android phone over USB or Wi-Fi, and control it all from the bar.

barWidget.description: Extend your desktop onto your phone, Sidecar-style. One click to see the connection, send windows and app sound to the phone, manage paired phones, and switch clipboard, sound and mic.

schema.label: Hide when idle
schema.description: Show the icon only while a phone is connected.
